title: Season Pass Programme: Group Pricing of Passes Bought on One Household Account
content:
Passes in the Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme bought on one household account for one season are priced as a group, not one at a time.

**The qualifying count.** The qualifying count is the number of pass records on the account in that season standing in the applied, pending activation, active, suspended or deferred states, counted before the new application is added. The number at which the account qualifies is 3.

**What the reduction does.** Once the account reaches the qualifying number of pass records for that season, the household reduction for the tier being bought is taken off that pass and off every further pass opened on the account for the same season. The percentage is the household reduction published for the tier being bought.

**Passes already opened.** Passes already opened at full price are not repriced backwards, because the reduction is worked out at the moment each application is recorded.

**Where the household reduction acts.** The household reduction is taken after the renewal reduction and is worked out on the price that reduction has already produced, never on the list price a second time.

**Where the household finances.** Where the household finances its passes, all pass records on the account for one season are financed on one plan, so the financed amount placed on the pass account is the sum of the household's pass prices less every deposit already taken.

### The count read as a sequence

The table follows a hypothetical household opening four applications on one account in one season, one after another, on tiers whose household reduction stands at 10 per cent.

| Application | Records already standing in the five states | Qualifying count reached | Household reduction on this pass |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| first | 0 | no | not taken |
| second | 1 | no | not taken |
| third | 2 | yes, the count reaches 3 with this record | taken |
| fourth | 3 | yes | taken |

The third application is the first to carry the reduction, and the first two are not repriced when it does.
